title: October 2026 Wood Fire Workshop
host_org: Tyler Park Center for the Arts
source_quote:
October 2026 Wood Fire Workshop
Oct 21-Nov 1
Loading Oct 24-25
Firing Oct 29-Nov 1
This will be a 40+ hour firing where we build ash and create a fair amount of atmospheric reduction during the firing.
evidence_sentence: The October 2026 Wood Fire Workshop page describes a wood firing lasting Oct 21-Nov 1, with loading, firing, and unloading days when participants perform scheduled stoking shifts.
summary: Bring 4+ cubic feet of bisqued cone-ten stoneware or porcelain. Participate in at least one 6-hour stoking shift and attend unloading. Cost is $300 including glazes. Registration open via link.
bring: 4+ cubic feet of bisqued cone-ten stoneware or porcelain ware; additional cubic feet available for extra charge
commitment: Oct 21-25 prep/glaze, Oct 29-Nov 1 firing (at least one 6-hour shift), Nov 1+ unload. Not all times required except unloading.
cost_text: $300 per participant (includes glaze and all firing materials)
how_to_join: Click link to register on Cognito Forms
